City of San Jose permit H25-039 (Site Development Permit/Amendment, folder year 2025), status Appealed, issue date 2026-07-22: "Site Development Permit to allow an eight-story residential building with 276 dwelling units, with five percent affordable units restricted to very-low-income, subject to the state Density Bonus Law, underground parking, and extended construction hours fr" (city text cut off at 255 characters)
City of San Jose permit PRE25-479 (Prelim - Focused (Policy Review, No Plans), folder year 2025), status Under Review: "SB330 Preapplication to construct 262 unit building"

Earlier plan: a six-story, 185,000 sq ft residential care facility with 169 units (165 rooms, 190 beds: 116 assisted living, 49 memory care), 32 parking spaces; Aedis Architects, landscape by The Guzzardo Partnership. Planning Commission hearing 2020-12-09 with staff recommending conditional approval. The 2020 article names the Thang Do and Chunhong Liu Trust as property owner.

City Council item on 2021-01-26 (file 21-137) covered General Plan Amendment GP19-012, rezoning C19-042, Conditional Use Permit CP20-019 and Vesting Tentative Map T20-020 for a residential care facility at this site.

2022: project named Gifford Place Senior Living (formerly Delmas), 167-unit assisted living facility on a 0.9-acre site; demolition of nine existing residential units complete by July 2022; funded by Urban Catalyst's Opportunity Zone Fund I.

2025 plan: eight-story building with 276 units, 14 very-low-income units under the State Density Bonus Law, five waivers, 217 underground parking spaces; CEQA statutory exemption under AB 130 (Public Resources Code 21080.66). Property owner named as Delmas Senior PropCo LLC, applicant Urban Catalyst.
Developer page: site repositioned from senior housing to market-rate multifamily, multifamily direction announced October 2025; adjacent Aquino project has 278 units, 554 homes combined.
